## Selected projects

- [Cache-aware scale-in for vLLM on Kubernetes](https://github.com/colmeabhi/cache-aware-scale-in): A Kubernetes controller that scores each vLLM replica's KV-cache hit rate and writes it to the pod-deletion-cost annotation, so a scale-down removes the coldest replica instead of an arbitrary one — fewer warm caches thrown away, lower time to first token.
- [Idempotent Order API](https://github.com/colmeabhi/idempotent-order-cloud-api): A retry-safe order service: the Idempotency-Key is claimed in the same Postgres transaction as the order, so concurrent duplicates get the same order back instead of a second order or a 500.
- [IaC Drift Reconciliation SaaS](https://github.com/Kunal23002/iac-drift-saas): Multi-tenant pipeline that reads CloudTrail across AWS accounts, finds console changes that drifted from CloudFormation, has an LLM on Bedrock rewrite the template, validates it with cfn-lint and opens a GitHub pull request.
- [Parallel N-body simulation](https://github.com/colmeabhi/parallelized-nbody-simulation-cuda-cpp): A galaxy simulation with five solvers compared like-for-like: SIMD serial, OpenMP, a Barnes–Hut octree, and naive versus shared-memory-tiled CUDA kernels.
- [AI Sprint Planning Assistant](https://devpost.com/colmeabhi): Turns a planning spreadsheet into Jira work with a RAG pipeline and multi-tool orchestration. Won the “Agents with Superpowers: Context Engineering Hackathon” sponsored by Composio and Redis.
- [SDN load balancer](https://github.com/colmeabhi/sdn-load-balance): A RYU (OpenFlow 1.3) controller that balances HTTP traffic to a virtual IP by installing rewrite rules straight into the switch, with five swappable algorithms.
